content.description: Exploded view of W58 transmission assembly showing internal components and housing

items: (a) Use two long clutch housing bolts, plate washers and suitable nuts as shown.

content.text: CAUTION: Install the plate washers in reverse of normal. Increase or decrease plate washers so that the bolt tip and the front tip surface of the nut are aligned.

items: (b) Mount the intermediate plate in a vise.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of four plugs using SST tool

items: (a) Using SST, remove the four plugs.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of springs and balls using magnetic finger

items: (b) Using a magnetic finger, remove the three springs and balls.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of shift fork set bolts

content.text: 8. REMOVE SHIFT FORKS, SHIFT FORK SHAFTS AND REVERSE IDLER GEAR

items: (a) Pry out the lock washers of No. 1 and No. 2 shift fork, and remove the two set bolts.

content.description: Illustration showing use of screwdrivers and hammer to tap out snap rings

items: (b) Using two screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the two snap rings of No. 1 and No. 2 fork shafts.
